certificates.title: TLS endpoints
certificates.description: Current state of explicitly configured direct-TLS endpoints. Each endpoint is checked separately, even when several endpoints serve the same certificate. Checks do not send HTTP requests or read private keys.
certificates.load_error: TLS endpoint monitoring state could not be loaded. No healthy result is assumed.
certificates.disabled: TLS endpoint monitoring is opt-in. Configure a root-owned targets file and set SECURITY_CERTIFICATE_MONITOR_ENABLED=true to enable it.

remediation.pending: Run the first check or wait for the immediate startup cycle.
remediation.coverage: Check DNS, TCP/TLS reachability and the endpoint chain; unknown is not healthy.
remediation.trust: Install a chain trusted by the server system store and reload the TLS service.
remediation.hostname: Serve a certificate matching the configured SNI/hostname.
remediation.expiry_warning: Schedule renewal and verify that the service reloads the renewed certificate.
remediation.expiry_critical: Renew immediately and verify the certificate served by this endpoint.
remediation.expiry_expired: Replace the expired certificate immediately and reload the TLS service.
remediation.expiry_not_yet_valid: Check issuance dates and host time before deploying this certificate.
remediation.healthy: No action required; periodic monitoring remains active.

refresh_error.invalid_request: The check request was rejected. No TLS endpoint check was started.
refresh_error.certificate_target_not_found: The configured TLS endpoint no longer exists. Reload the current state.
refresh_error.certificate_refresh_busy: A scheduled or manual TLS endpoint check is already running. Retry shortly.
refresh_error.certificate_refresh_cooldown: This TLS endpoint was just checked. Retry in {{seconds}} seconds.
refresh_error.certificate_monitor_unavailable: The TLS endpoint check could not be completed safely. The stored state may be unchanged.
refresh_error.invalid_response: The TLS endpoint check result could not be verified. Reload the current state before retrying.

trust.title: Trust the current whole snapshot?
trust.description: Accept observed generation {{observedGeneration}} as the new whole-snapshot baseline (current baseline {{baselineGeneration}})? This resolves matching incidents. Acknowledging an event alone never changes the baseline.
trust.success: The current integrity snapshot is now trusted.

reenroll.title: Re-enroll a corrupt baseline?
reenroll.description: Replace the corrupt baseline at state revision {{stateRevision}} with complete observed generation {{observedGeneration}}? This creates a new trust-on-first-use boundary and does not prove that the current files are clean.
reenroll.success: The integrity baseline was re-enrolled from the reviewed observation.

action_error.safe: The integrity action failed. No baseline change was confirmed.
action_error.invalid_request: The request was rejected. Close this dialog and review the current status.
action_error.stale_generation: The integrity state changed. Close this dialog and review the refreshed generations before confirming again.
action_error.not_initialized: No baseline has been initialized. Review the current status.
action_error.no_drift: There is no current drift to trust. Review the refreshed status.
action_error.observation_not_trustable: The current observation is incomplete or unsafe to trust.
action_error.recovery_not_required: Baseline recovery is no longer required. Review the current status.
action_error.unsupported_algorithm: This binary cannot safely replace a baseline that uses an unsupported algorithm.
action_error.internal_error: The action could not be completed safely. You can retry without changing the captured snapshot.
